block_order: baseline-r2 fresh fleet (continuation after rejected window)
provenance.transport_test: Two bridge tests passed: ordered binary flow and nested HTTP/Upgrade; original adapter files byte-identical.
provenance.exact_container_locations: not exposed by the inspected provider response

read_only_audit_retry_policy.applies_after: Original candidate r1 audit transport interruption
read_only_audit_retry_policy.retryable: Connection-reset/disconnected/timeout exceptions, or typed route HTTP 500 with connection-closed cause only

provenance.baseline_second_repetition: Fresh isolated R2 bucket and fleet identity after full-filesystem-loss recovery refused admission. Same baseline image, runtime settings, 3,000 counters and reversed workload.
provenance.operator_only_gateway_update: Added authenticated stop/diagnostics routes for three fixed benchmark cohorts; stop no longer starts a stopped container. Counter and peer request paths unchanged.

order: baseline-r2 fresh fleet (remaining cases measured after rejected window)

aggregation.goodput: Sum of HTTP 200 responses divided by sum of client run durations
aggregation.percentiles: Worse per-run percentile across two repetitions; not pooled percentiles

untimed_audit_interruption.stage: Candidate repetition 1, distributed GET c64, verification after warmup and before timed load
untimed_audit_interruption.client_failure: HTTP 500: peer connection closed before message completed
untimed_audit_interruption.interpretation: Transient peer connection closure observed; exact initiating cause not established. Cellar refused the ambiguous remote attempt.
untimed_audit_interruption.resumption: Resume at incomplete window; retain prior completed windows and interrupted artifacts. Bound and journal read-only audit retries. Timed clients and all POSTs keep zero retries.

baseline_recovery_failure.loss_case: All three prior ephemeral container filesystems destroyed after preserving native stops
baseline_recovery_failure.observed: Recovery refuses to seal predecessor logs while former witness members remain undecided
baseline_recovery_failure.interpretation: Fleet acknowledgments may precede bucket upload. Preserving local shutdown plus discarding every local replica is not a qualified bucket-only recovery boundary.
baseline_recovery_failure.resolution: Preserve original bucket and failure evidence; stop refused nodes and use a fresh independent baseline bucket for repetition 2. This is a fresh performance repetition, not successful data recovery.

baseline_write_failure.label: r2-post-many-c32
baseline_write_failure.classification: Unqualified sample: ambiguous writes; no mutation replay performed. Aggregate counts alone do not identify individual operations.
